e27b1db8-9ec9-4f8b-9ca6-fd6377de66ee.name: Adventureland Treehouse inspired by Walt Disney’s Swiss Family Robinson
e27b1db8-9ec9-4f8b-9ca6-fd6377de66ee.expect: Outdoor walk-through treehouse, lots of stairs up and down, no ride vehicle, a little high up.

a07f3110-013e-43bb-a182-e66bb8b5e28d.name: Alice in Wonderland
a07f3110-013e-43bb-a182-e66bb8b5e28d.expect: Slow caterpillar cars through dark scenes, then outside on a raised winding track, a few pop-ups.

6c225598-91c9-44a3-95e2-7c423475db61.name: Astro Orbitor
6c225598-91c9-44a3-95e2-7c423475db61.expect: Outdoor rocket spinner, you control the height, circles fast and fairly high, can feel dizzy.

1da85181-bf0f-4ccc-b98e-243142f7347b.name: Autopia

1da85181-bf0f-4ccc-b98e-243142f7347b.expect: Outdoor gas cars on a guided track at low speed, loud engines, light bumps from the car behind.

0de1413a-73ee-46cf-af2e-c491cc7c7d3b.name: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad
0de1413a-73ee-46cf-af2e-c491cc7c7d3b.expect: Outdoor mine-train coaster, fast turns and small dips, short dark tunnels, rattly, no big drops.

888525b0-5a6f-4b8e-9f07-b6a32812b04d.name: Bluey’s Best Day Ever! at Fantasyland Theatre
888525b0-5a6f-4b8e-9f07-b6a32812b04d.expect: Live stage show in an open-air covered theater, Bluey and Bingo with a live band, sing and dance along.

88197808-3c56-4198-a5a4-6066541251cf.name: Buzz Lightyear Astro Blasters
88197808-3c56-4198-a5a4-6066541251cf.expect: Indoor dark ride, shoot laser blasters at targets, you can spin your own car, bright and noisy.

8e686e4c-f3db-4d9c-a185-2d54b1fa8899.name: Casey Jr. Circus Train
8e686e4c-f3db-4d9c-a185-2d54b1fa8899.expect: Outdoor little circus train, slow, gentle hills and curves around Storybook Land.

59647168-d239-4161-8b24-92eb128e96fb.name: Chip 'n' Dale's GADGETcoaster
59647168-d239-4161-8b24-92eb128e96fb.expect: Short outdoor kid coaster, under a minute, quick tight turns and small dips, a bit jerky.

5bd95ae8-181d-449c-8f04-a621e2448961.name: Davy Crockett's Explorer Canoes
5bd95ae8-181d-449c-8f04-a621e2448961.expect: Outdoor canoe on the river, everyone paddles with guides, slow, splashes from paddles possible.

37858b2a-9c11-4ac6-9f8d-db7fa9088703.name: The Disney Gallery
37858b2a-9c11-4ac6-9f8d-db7fa9088703.expect: Quiet indoor art gallery on Main Street, concept art and models, walk through at your own pace.

56d0bd6d-5106-4420-8f60-0005475c04c3.name: Disneyland Monorail
56d0bd6d-5106-4420-8f60-0005475c04c3.expect: Elevated monorail, seated, smooth ride with views, loops out to Downtown Disney and back.

e2d460e9-2bef-4613-b126-092ab7cb37e5.name: Disneyland Railroad
e2d460e9-2bef-4613-b126-092ab7cb37e5.expect: Steam train circling the park, open-air cars, loud whistle, a dim tunnel with dinosaur scenes.

ca32ef8a-ae0d-4c24-bf4f-e59192122e01.name: Donald's Duck Pond
ca32ef8a-ae0d-4c24-bf4f-e59192122e01.expect: Outdoor play area around Donald's boat, spinning water lilies and rocking toys, a splash zone.

cc980e8e-192f-48b6-848c-27784084e54b.name: Dumbo the Flying Elephant
cc980e8e-192f-48b6-848c-27784084e54b.expect: Outdoor flying elephants circle slowly, you control how high, open-air and gentle.

64d44aaa-6857-4693-b24b-bcff6c6dcfa1.name: Finding Nemo Submarine Voyage
64d44aaa-6857-4693-b24b-bcff6c6dcfa1.expect: Seated in a narrow submarine looking out portholes, slow, cramped, a dark part with a loud rumble.

c2997e65-6db0-413f-a2db-ee995711d931.name: Fortune Tellers
c2997e65-6db0-413f-a2db-ee995711d931.expect: Coin-operated fortune teller machines with moving figures, stand and watch, a short spoken fortune.

835deb74-de54-4d7f-9dc4-dacab90fcb60.name: Frontierland Shootin' Exposition
835deb74-de54-4d7f-9dc4-dacab90fcb60.expect: Shooting gallery with light rifles, targets move and make sounds, some loud bangs and effects.

b0eca3d3-a519-47f9-a5a7-9911126da2df.name: Goofy's How-to-Play Yard
b0eca3d3-a519-47f9-a5a7-9911126da2df.expect: Outdoor play yard, climb up to a raised clubhouse, a noise-making sound garden, hands-on toys.

1b23667a-d8fb-436d-8952-c3e3f2e56d13.name: Great Moments with Mr. Lincoln
1b23667a-d8fb-436d-8952-c3e3f2e56d13.expect: Seated indoor theater, a lifelike Abraham Lincoln figure gives a speech, dim and quiet, lobby exhibits.

ff52cb64-c1d5-4feb-9d43-5dbd429bac81.name: Haunted Mansion Holiday
ff52cb64-c1d5-4feb-9d43-5dbd429bac81.expect: Slow dark ride in moving chairs, spooky holiday scenes, a stretching room in the dark, some startles.

2aedc657-1ee2-4545-a1ce-14753f28cc66.name: Indiana Jones™ Adventure
2aedc657-1ee2-4545-a1ce-14753f28cc66.expect: Jerky jeep ride in the dark, loud bangs, fire, snakes, bugs and a giant rolling boulder, many startles.

3638ac09-9fce-4a43-8c79-8ebbe17afce2.name: "it's a small world"
3638ac09-9fce-4a43-8c79-8ebbe17afce2.expect: Slow boat through bright singing doll scenes, indoor and cheerful, very gentle, a catchy song.

1b83fda8-d60e-48e4-9a3d-90ddcbcd1001.name: Jungle Cruise
1b83fda8-d60e-48e4-9a3d-90ddcbcd1001.expect: Outdoor boat with a joking skipper, animal figures, a short dim temple part, rarely a light spray.

11209961-2ac2-4f76-a11b-ed793939f796.name: Key to Disneyland
11209961-2ac2-4f76-a11b-ed793939f796.expect: Self-paced hunt for lock stations around the park with a purchased light-up key, lights and music.

f7904912-3f08-4563-b99e-fd59f43cc9f2.name: King Arthur Carrousel
f7904912-3f08-4563-b99e-fd59f43cc9f2.expect: Classic outdoor carousel, horses go gently up and down, organ music, slow and steady.

e0cfed11-96d7-40f3-907f-5cfed172592a.name: Mad Tea Party
e0cfed11-96d7-40f3-907f-5cfed172592a.expect: Outdoor spinning teacups, you turn the center wheel to spin faster or slower, can get very dizzy.

f5bb0d14-7eee-4ede-9230-eb256ce3664c.name: Main Street Cinema
f5bb0d14-7eee-4ede-9230-eb256ce3664c.expect: Small dim room showing classic black-and-white Mickey cartoons on several screens, standing.

4e239b89-a794-4bb2-a32f-736e04416695.name: Main Street Pumpkin Festival
4e239b89-a794-4bb2-a32f-736e04416695.expect: Outdoor seasonal display of carved pumpkins on Main Street, look and take photos, nothing moves.

bcfd1e17-3eab-4203-b597-6257a257d427.name: Main Street Vehicles
bcfd1e17-3eab-4203-b597-6257a257d427.expect: One-way trip down Main Street on a vintage vehicle such as a horse-drawn streetcar, slow, open-air.

52a8ef64-d54c-4974-883f-027c3026e3f1.name: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
52a8ef64-d54c-4974-883f-027c3026e3f1.expect: Slow beehive cars through dim storybook scenes, a bouncy Tigger part, a trippy dream room.

6c30d5b0-8c0a-406f-9258-0b6c55d4a5e4.name: Mark Twain Riverboat
6c30d5b0-8c0a-406f-9258-0b6c55d4a5e4.expect: Large outdoor steamboat on the river, stand or sit, slow and smooth, a loud steam whistle.

faaa8be9-cc1e-4535-ac20-04a535654bd0.name: Matterhorn Bobsleds
faaa8be9-cc1e-4535-ac20-04a535654bd0.expect: Rough bobsled coaster in and out of a mountain, sharp jerky turns, dark parts, a roaring snow monster.

cd670bff-81d1-4f34-8676-7bafdf49220a.name: Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway
cd670bff-81d1-4f34-8676-7bafdf49220a.expect: Indoor trackless cartoon ride, cars dance and twirl past big projection screens, loud but not scary.

b2c2549c-e9da-4fdd-98ea-1dcff596fed7.name: Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run
b2c2549c-e9da-4fdd-98ea-1dcff596fed7.expect: Simulator cockpit facing a big screen, you pilot or shoot, jolts and lurches, can cause motion sickness.

c02fb82d-0860-4e95-8c61-899fa594d20e.name: Minnie's House
c02fb82d-0860-4e95-8c61-899fa594d20e.expect: Walk-through of Minnie's cartoon house, touchable gadgets and props, indoor and calm.

9d401ad3-49b2-469f-ac73-93eb429428fb.name: Mr. Toad's Wild Ride
9d401ad3-49b2-469f-ac73-93eb429428fb.expect: Jerky car through dark crash scenes, loud, a train headlight rushes at you, ends in a fiery hell scene.

6e2af074-3a67-4f38-9bcf-2f5a572c87df.name: Opera House - Walt Disney - A Magical Life
6e2af074-3a67-4f38-9bcf-2f5a572c87df.expect: Indoor theater and lobby exhibits, a short film and a lifelike Walt Disney figure, calm and seated.

c23af6ba-8515-406a-8a48-d0818ba0bfc9.name: Peter Pan's Flight
c23af6ba-8515-406a-8a48-d0818ba0bfc9.expect: Pirate ships hang from an overhead track and glide through dark scenes, feels high over London, gentle.

90ee50d4-7cc9-4824-b29d-2aac801acc29.name: Pinocchio's Daring Journey
90ee50d4-7cc9-4824-b29d-2aac801acc29.expect: Slow dark ride with some creepy parts, boys turning into donkeys, a whale that lunges out.

07952343-3498-404b-8337-734de9a185c1.name: Pirate's Lair on Tom Sawyer Island
07952343-3498-404b-8337-734de9a185c1.expect: Raft over to an island to explore caves, wobbly bridges and forts on foot, some dark tunnels.

82aeb29b-504a-416f-b13f-f41fa5b766aa.name: Pirates of the Caribbean
82aeb29b-504a-416f-b13f-f41fa5b766aa.expect: Slow boat through dark pirate scenes, two short drops in the dark, loud cannon fire, a little splash.

526ada11-4688-442b-96d4-4077eac4f988.name: Pixar Short Film Spotlight
526ada11-4688-442b-96d4-4077eac4f988.expect: Seated indoor theater showing three Pixar short films, about 20 minutes, calm.

6ce9cdd1-0a43-459e-83cd-f4cace9cfa7b.name: Roger Rabbit's Car Toon Spin
6ce9cdd1-0a43-459e-83cd-f4cace9cfa7b.expect: Indoor dark ride in cabs you can spin with a wheel, loud busy cartoon scenes, a few surprises.

c9e39189-7e99-4e0a-97e0-4a0d5654d257.name: Sailing Ship Columbia
c9e39189-7e99-4e0a-97e0-4a0d5654d257.expect: Full-size sailing ship on the river, stand on deck, slow and smooth, a small museum below deck.

90d5a091-478c-4df1-adfe-c605b4005013.name: Sleeping Beauty Castle Walkthrough
90d5a091-478c-4df1-adfe-c605b4005013.expect: Walk through the castle up and down narrow stairs, dim storybook dioramas, a Maleficent scene.

4f0053e7-b8db-4833-b02f-35e1c91b4523.name: Snow White's Enchanted Wish
4f0053e7-b8db-4833-b02f-35e1c91b4523.expect: Slow mine cart through dark scenes, the witch appears a few times, happy ending, gentle motion.

9167db1d-e5e7-46da-a07f-ae30a87bc4c4.name: Space Mountain
9167db1d-e5e7-46da-a07f-ae30a87bc4c4.expect: Fast indoor coaster almost entirely in the dark, sudden turns and dips, loud music, no big drops.

cc718d11-fa15-44ee-87d0-ded989ad61bc.name: Star Tours - The Adventures Continue
cc718d11-fa15-44ee-87d0-ded989ad61bc.expect: Motion simulator theater with 3D glasses and a big screen, bumpy jolts and swoops, can cause motion sickness.

34b1d70f-11c4-42df-935e-d5582c9f1a8e.name: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
34b1d70f-11c4-42df-935e-d5582c9f1a8e.expect: Long walk-through story, then trackless cars, loud blasters, huge AT-ATs, a short sudden drop at the end.

cb929138-d77a-4dd2-983c-f651bbd1bd92.name: Storybook Land Canal Boats
cb929138-d77a-4dd2-983c-f651bbd1bd92.expect: Outdoor boat past tiny storybook villages, very slow, starts through a dim whale's mouth.

a9076acd-7630-4bad-a8da-e6bd689ddcac.name: Tiana's Bayou Adventure
a9076acd-7630-4bad-a8da-e6bd689ddcac.expect: Log boat through dark scenes and small dips, then a steep 50-foot drop outdoors, you will get wet.

05b17c11-fd4c-4b85-ab45-3e269dc56559.name: Walt Disney - A Magical Life
05b17c11-fd4c-4b85-ab45-3e269dc56559.expect: Seated indoor theater, a short film then a lifelike Walt Disney figure speaks, calm and quiet.

106c1e5a-a5e7-42d7-96ab-bc100d8faf71.name: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room
106c1e5a-a5e7-42d7-96ab-bc100d8faf71.expect: Seated indoor show of singing animated birds and flowers, a dark thunderstorm part with loud thunder.

d2aa0987-49a2-45dc-a635-3a8bf7401230.name: Animation Academy
d2aa0987-49a2-45dc-a635-3a8bf7401230.expect: Sit at an easel and follow a Disney artist step by step to draw a character, indoor, calm.

eb77ee1f-3207-44fd-acfc-d7bc18602007.name: The Bakery Tour
eb77ee1f-3207-44fd-acfc-d7bc18602007.expect: Short indoor walk past a working bakery with video hosts, a free bread sample, calm.

1d24dd7a-372b-4195-8ad0-ba9679d72b08.name: Games of Pixar Pier
1d24dd7a-372b-4195-8ad0-ba9679d72b08.expect: Outdoor carnival games along the pier, pay to play, tossing and aiming games for prizes.

10a5fc6f-5ad3-414b-9bdd-e6bae097b6ad.name: Golden Zephyr
10a5fc6f-5ad3-414b-9bdd-e6bae097b6ad.expect: Outdoor rocket cars hang from a tower and swing out in slow wide circles over the bay, smooth.

f44a5072-3cda-4c7c-8574-33ad09d16cca.name: Goofy's Sky School
f44a5072-3cda-4c7c-8574-33ad09d16cca.expect: Outdoor wild-mouse coaster, sharp hairpin turns that feel like going over the edge, small drops.

b1d285a7-2444-4a7c-b7bb-d2d4d6428a85.expect: Round raft spins down outdoor rapids with two drops, one fairly big, you will likely get soaked.

b7678dab-5544-48d5-8fdc-c1a0127cfbcd.expect: Indoor drop tower, launched up and dropped again and again, floating airtime, loud music, brief views.

2108cc58-80df-4fff-9b91-735e89873ffd.name: Guardians of the Galaxy - Monsters After Dark
2108cc58-80df-4fff-9b91-735e89873ffd.heightNote: Halloween overlay of Guardians Mission BREAKOUT, same requirement
2108cc58-80df-4fff-9b91-735e89873ffd.expect: Same drop tower as BREAKOUT with a spooky monster story, repeated big drops in the dark, loud.

5d07a2b1-49ca-4de7-9d32-6d08edf69b08.name: Incredicoaster
5d07a2b1-49ca-4de7-9d32-6d08edf69b08.expect: Big outdoor coaster, a fast launch, a vertical loop, tall drops, high speed over the water.

6d876f4c-c3ff-4ae3-a2d8-d4b831e1039b.name: Inside Out Emotional Whirlwind
6d876f4c-c3ff-4ae3-a2d8-d4b831e1039b.expect: Gentle open-air spinner, round cars circle and turn a little, short and mild.

388ad3f1-5cf5-4a9d-8d0e-6dfb817d7822.name: Jessie's Critter Carousel
388ad3f1-5cf5-4a9d-8d0e-6dfb817d7822.expect: Outdoor carousel of Toy Story critter figures that bob up and down, slow and gentle.

c8a4b7b1-c1b2-4dfe-b73c-4e834b4a73db.name: Jumpin' Jellyfish
c8a4b7b1-c1b2-4dfe-b73c-4e834b4a73db.expect: Outdoor kid tower, seats rise about 40 feet and bounce gently down a few times, a feel of height.

e1fbc7a1-2cd1-4282-b373-ac11d9d9d38a.name: The Little Mermaid - Ariel's Undersea Adventure
e1fbc7a1-2cd1-4282-b373-ac11d9d9d38a.expect: Slow clamshell cars through bright and dim scenes, a tilt back to go under the sea, an Ursula scene.

7a09a2f0-e226-4f3e-86f8-2598ab67ec44.name: Luigi's Honkin' Haul-O-Ween
7a09a2f0-e226-4f3e-86f8-2598ab67ec44.heightNote: Seasonal overlay of Luigi's Rollickin' Roadsters, same requirement
7a09a2f0-e226-4f3e-86f8-2598ab67ec44.expect: Open-air cars with no track glide and twirl around a floor to Halloween music, mild spinning.

46097afe-a1ea-4807-93d3-14d14f36e55f.name: Mater's Graveyard JamBOOree
46097afe-a1ea-4807-93d3-14d14f36e55f.heightNote: Seasonal overlay of Mater's Junkyard Jamboree, same requirement
46097afe-a1ea-4807-93d3-14d14f36e55f.expect: Outdoor whip ride, small tractor carts swing around sharp turns and nearly collide, Halloween music.

8f586a2f-cef5-46d3-b822-fd622c4e9e33.name: Mickey's PhilharMagic
8f586a2f-cef5-46d3-b822-fd622c4e9e33.expect: Seated 3D movie with glasses, loud music, air puffs, light water sprays and scents, about 12 minutes.

40524fba-5d84-49e7-9204-f493dbe2d5a4.name: Monsters, Inc. Mike & Sulley to the Rescue!
40524fba-5d84-49e7-9204-f493dbe2d5a4.expect: Slow taxi cars through dark cartoon scenes, a few loud alarms and a lurking Randall, gentle.

4ca6cdbf-4c5f-45bf-b0dc-db83393ec208.name: Pixar Pal-A-Round – Non-Swinging
4ca6cdbf-4c5f-45bf-b0dc-db83393ec208.expect: Tall outdoor Ferris wheel in fixed gondolas, slow and steady, high views over the park.

528016ef-db24-47fa-a0f2-b6d26d61e29f.name: Pixar Pal-A-Round - Swinging
528016ef-db24-47fa-a0f2-b6d26d61e29f.expect: Tall Ferris wheel with gondolas that slide and swing hard on inner rails, high up, stomach drops.

c60c768b-3461-465c-8f4f-b44b087506fc.name: Radiator Springs Racers
c60c768b-3461-465c-8f4f-b44b087506fc.expect: Slow scenic drive and indoor scenes, then a fast side-by-side outdoor race with dips and banked turns.

c9803366-6f37-4406-82af-7692357e3ca9.name: Redwood Creek Challenge Trail
c9803366-6f37-4406-82af-7692357e3ca9.heightNote: Some parts: rock climb 42 in., log slides 32 in., training tower 42 to 63 in. and age 12 or under
c9803366-6f37-4406-82af-7692357e3ca9.expect: Outdoor play trail with rope bridges, slides, climbing walls and lookout towers, on foot.

4f5b28d0-b78e-482b-8e2e-1f90756d6220.name: Silly Symphony Swings
4f5b28d0-b78e-482b-8e2e-1f90756d6220.heightNote: 48 in. to ride a single swing alone; 40 to 48 in. rides a tandem swing with a responsible person
4f5b28d0-b78e-482b-8e2e-1f90756d6220.expect: Outdoor swing ride, chairs fly out in wide fast circles and tilt, a feel of height.

77f205a4-d482-4d91-a5ff-71e54a086ad2.name: Soarin’ Across America
77f205a4-d482-4d91-a5ff-71e54a086ad2.expect: Seats lift you up in front of a giant dome screen, gentle gliding motion, scents, feet dangle high.

44c1f655-25d3-440c-b1a8-db736a12b105.name: Sorcerer's Workshop
44c1f655-25d3-440c-b1a8-db736a12b105.expect: Indoor hands-on rooms with screens, animate a drawing and take a character quiz, calm.

86ab3069-110d-49c5-a7e7-29ddf28695a6.name: Toy Story Midway Mania!
86ab3069-110d-49c5-a7e7-29ddf28695a6.expect: Indoor 3D shooting game with glasses, cars turn between big screens, air puffs and light spritzes.

75dfd5ed-4bfb-4727-b24a-bf5fb2284950.name: Treat Trails at Oogie Boogie Bash
75dfd5ed-4bfb-4727-b24a-bf5fb2284950.expect: Nighttime outdoor walking trails with candy stations, only during the separate-ticket Halloween party.

7561bcd8-18ea-4e3f-89d5-c905b7ba3d42.name: Turtle Talk with Crush
7561bcd8-18ea-4e3f-89d5-c905b7ba3d42.expect: Indoor show where an animated Crush on a big screen chats live with kids, sit on the floor.

24066306-d364-4048-b4c9-a0e81980c5b4.name: Villains Grove at Oogie Boogie Bash
24066306-d364-4048-b4c9-a0e81980c5b4.expect: Nighttime outdoor walk-through with villain lighting, projections and music, spooky mood, party only.

2295351d-ce6b-4c04-92d5-5b416372c5b5.name: WEB SLINGERS: A Spider-Man Adventure
2295351d-ce6b-4c04-92d5-5b416372c5b5.expect: Indoor 3D screen game with glasses, fling webs with hand motions, cars turn but move gently.

ab058c94-3bc3-4944-b4b5-c5c76de73575.name: GhostRider
ab058c94-3bc3-4944-b4b5-c5c76de73575.expect: Giant wooden coaster: 118 ft first drop, 14 hills, rough and fast, about 3 minutes.

53c1481b-186f-4e3d-a239-3e68e29674a0.name: Silver Bullet
53c1481b-186f-4e3d-a239-3e68e29674a0.expect: Inverted coaster, feet dangling: 6 upside-downs including a 105 ft loop.

7b3ed978-a4fe-46aa-9255-1a8d87d1a5b7.name: Xcelerator The Ride®
7b3ed978-a4fe-46aa-9255-1a8d87d1a5b7.expect: Launch from 0 to 82 mph in 2.3 seconds, straight up 205 ft and a 90-degree drop. Very short.

8b7a8285-2ef9-40ed-a8c1-e6dc775fb6f2.name: HangTime
8b7a8285-2ef9-40ed-a8c1-e6dc775fb6f2.expect: Dive coaster: a 96-degree beyond-vertical drop, then 5 upside-downs.

6fce6f53-0cd1-468a-b2c1-6cad0f62e407.name: Supreme Scream
6fce6f53-0cd1-468a-b2c1-6cad0f62e407.expect: Drop tower: up 252 ft, then down in about 3 seconds.

7a7c3242-c63c-46b5-a8dd-9685ea90f747.name: Sol Spin
7a7c3242-c63c-46b5-a8dd-9685ea90f747.expect: Six arms swing you six stories up and spin you head over heels.
